title: Budgets

empty.title: No budgets yet
empty.description: Create your first budget to start tracking your spending limits.

scope: Current configured periods · durable plan currencies · displayed in {{currency}}
currentContext: Current configured period · plan status (not the selected actual-spending range)

actual.title: Category spending
actual.scope: Gross actuals for active single-category plans, across all source accounts and tags. This independent view does not apply plan account/tag filters or net measures, and does not compare historical limits.
actual.chartHint: Bars compare complete actual spending only; no budget targets.
actual.noMain: Set a main currency in Settings to see comparable category amounts. Native evidence is shown below.
actual.incomplete: Incomplete evidence · {{count}} unresolved references. Inspect the details below.
actual.emptyCategories: Add a budget to track a category here.
actual.emptySpending: No eligible expenses recorded in these categories for these dates.

currency.description: Complete spending data and valid exchange rates are required to display progress.
currency.setupRequired: Configure a main currency in Settings before creating a budget.
currency.changedWhileOpen: The main currency changed while this form was open. Close and reopen it before saving.

buckets.title: Virtual cashflow buckets
buckets.description: Reserve recorded income for upcoming priorities, grouped in each bucket's native currency.
buckets.disclaimer: Virtual balances organize your plan only. They do not change bank accounts or transactions.

dialog.editorDescription: Bucket IDs and allocation history remain unchanged.
dialog.allocateDescription: Choose eligible recorded income or explicitly create an unbound virtual allocation.
dialog.correctDescription: Review an atomic reversal and replacement. Historical rows are never deleted.

funding.confirmUnbound: I understand this is a virtual allocation without a source transaction and does not move bank money.

preview.title: Reviewed correction
preview.atomicHistory: The original stays intact; a signed reversal and replacement will be appended atomically.

confirm.deleteDescription: Only an empty bucket with no allocation history can be deleted.
confirm.reverseDescription: A signed reversal will be appended. The original historical row will remain.

empty.title: No virtual buckets
empty.description: Create a native-currency bucket to organize recorded income without changing your accounts.

error.confirmUnbound: Confirm that this is an unbound virtual allocation.
error.correct: Couldn't apply the correction. Review a fresh preview and try again.

scoped.scopeHelp: Match any selected value within each group, and all groups together. Exclusions win. Empty inclusion means all. Categories are exact (no descendants); accounts and tags belong to the recognition transaction, including refunds—not the original purchase.
scoped.windowHelp: Leave both custom dates empty to use the reference period. The default cutoff is as of today; future posted rows require the period-end option. Stored transaction dates never shift.
scoped.allScope: All source accounts, categories and tags
scoped.invalidScope: Invalid stored scope. No unrestricted total can be inferred.
scoped.incomplete: Incomplete · totals are unknown, not zero
scoped.contributorHelp: Each parent appears once. Selected allocations determine this result; the full parent is context only and must not be added again. Unresolved candidates are included. Open a transaction to inspect or edit using its existing workflow.
scoped.estimateHelp: Current active expense definitions, expressed as monthly/yearly frequency equivalents—not paid actuals, occurrence counts, or historical forecasts. Month grouping uses the definition’s as-of month.
scoped.noCombinedEstimate: No combined total: overlap between rules and subscriptions is unknown.
scoped.reportDescription: Scoped actuals, classified consumption and separate recurring estimates
scoped.currentDefinition: Current definitions applied to the selected dates; no historical plan versions are inferred.
scoped.currencyReentry: Changing currency clears the amount. Re-enter it explicitly; no automatic FX conversion. Existing legacy denominations are not reinterpreted.
scoped.notComparable: This range spans plan periods. Limit comparison, remaining and percentage are unavailable.
scoped.budgetScope: Each plan uses its own stored currency, scope and measure. Actual category spending below is a separate gross view; it does not sum limits or duplicate plans.
scoped.nonAdditive: Budgets may overlap and use different periods or currencies. Their usage and limits are not additive.

issues.unsupported_subscription_tags: Subscriptions do not support tag filtering

scoped.budgetUsageComplete: Budget usage is complete; other report measures are incomplete.
